QUOTE: "`not_indexed` for extensions the index never reads (here `.rs`, `.toml`, `.csv`, `.sql`, extensionless files and so on)" and "Name that would live in a file with an unindexed extension (`.rs`, `.toml`, `.sql`, …) | No evidence either way. The index never read those files, so this is the 'did not look there' case."

VERDICT: MISS

WHY: The answer distinguishes "not indexed" file types from searched ones, but it never says the reply also names the in-scope file types that produced no rows. The item needs that specific fact, and the answer only lists the unindexed extensions and the indexed ones in general.
